# Rattler interoperability fixture

The package and its CEP 27 publication sidecar are copied byte for byte from [Rattler's Sigstore fixtures at commit `8f787486704a997bb4266806ef348f07aa64d928`](https://github.com/conda/rattler/tree/8f787486704a997bb4266806ef348f07aa64d928/test-data/sigstore). `manifest.json` records their source URLs, SHA-256 digests, artifact name, target channel, and authenticated certificate identity and issuer.

The public producer is [the skill-forge package workflow at commit `8a96d273f7245383c451499fb65375ec408ca042`](https://github.com/pavelzw/skill-forge/blob/8a96d273f7245383c451499fb65375ec408ca042/.github/workflows/package.yml), with [the corresponding workflow run](https://github.com/pavelzw/skill-forge/actions/runs/36007002754). Its [locked environment](https://github.com/pavelzw/skill-forge/blob/8a96d273f7245383c451499fb65375ec408ca042/pixi.lock) uses Rattler-Build 0.74.0 (`linux-64`, build `hf01adef_0`). This frozen fixture does not establish compatibility with every later producer release. The attestation authenticates the recorded GitHub Actions identity and binds the exact package name, digest, and `https://prefix.dev/skill-forge` target channel. Successful verification does not establish that the channel authorized that identity.

`trusted_root.json` and `signing_config.v0.2.json` come from [Sigstore's root-signing repository at commit `67e8656ef7950b2dd70c96eb35c6f07a68b72404`](https://github.com/sigstore/root-signing/tree/67e8656ef7950b2dd70c96eb35c6f07a68b72404/targets). `client_trust_config.json` combines them in the client trust configuration format used by sigstore-python. Their hashes are recorded in the manifest. Tests load these frozen files with `offline=True` and reject network calls. These snapshots make the tests reproducible. They are not a deployment trust source and provide no mechanism for authenticated updates, freshness, or rollback protection.

The tests serve the same sidecar bytes through a local recording fetcher to exercise both repodata-selected `.sigs.<sha256>` and adjacent `.v0.sigs` retrieval. This does not claim that the public channel advertises the fixture through both transports. The malformed inputs and changed payloads used in rejection tests are constructed in memory, leaving the original fixture intact.

Rattler's BSD-3-Clause license is reproduced in `LICENSE-rattler`. The package contains the original conda-forge BSD-3-Clause license at `info/licenses/LICENSE`. Sigstore's root-signing files are covered by the Apache-2.0 license reproduced in `LICENSE-sigstore`.
